title: IEEE journal graphics

scope.publication: IEEE journals (general author-center guidance; confirm exact journal)

coverage_note: Partial profile; only listed rules covered. Check current article-specific and editorial instructions.

rules.summary: Graphics may be submitted as PS, EPS, PDF, PNG, or TIFF; Office formats have an original-drawing condition and JPEG is for author photos only.
rules.source_summary: Graphics may be submitted as PS, EPS, PDF, PNG, or TIFF; Office formats have an original-drawing condition and JPEG is for author photos only.

rules.summary: For EPS, PS, or PDF, embed fonts or convert text to outlines.
rules.source_summary: For EPS, PS, or PDF, embed fonts or convert text to outlines.

rules.summary: Name graphics using the first five letters of the primary author surname and sequential figure number.
rules.source_summary: Name graphics using the first five letters of the primary author surname and sequential figure number.

rules.summary: Table file names use the first five surname letters, .t, and the table number.
rules.source_summary: Table file names use the first five surname letters, .t, and the table number.

rules.summary: Type should appear approximately 9–10 points at full size.
rules.source_summary: Type should appear approximately 9–10 points at full size.

rules.summary: Keep typeface and size consistent across graphics and tables.
rules.source_summary: Keep typeface and size consistent across graphics and tables.
